scope: Top-level Pascal source units shipped in bin/Lib; external .NET assemblies and SPython are outside this inventory.
implementation: native/src/big_integer.cpp, big_integer_runtime.cpp, stdlib.cpp, random.cpp, console_input.cpp, console_output.cpp, formatting.cpp, string_arrays.cpp, school.cpp, school_text.cpp, files.cpp, file_moves.cpp, file_operations.cpp, text_file.cpp, pascal.cpp, bytecode.cpp, vm.cpp, linked.hpp, integer_values.hpp
unit_loading: PABCSystem is implicit. Explicit uses PABCSystem, Arrays, Collections, FilesOperations, School enables implemented built-ins. Events and PointRect are empty compatibility units in the shipped source and import without side effects. Catalog entries retain unit ownership; FilesOperations exports require uses. Qualified catalog calls bypass user routine shadowing; variables still shadow unit names. Pascal source units and old PCU files are not loaded.

typed_capabilities.biginteger_language: Distinct statically known BigInteger type and immutable Value alternative, default zero, decimal bi literals, numeric constructors and checked explicit casts. Fixed integers/char widen to BigInteger; real conversion explicit. Arithmetic, signed bitwise/shifts, truncating div/mod, BigInteger/BigInteger integer division and mixed real division with both arguments evaluated before body conversion. Native Abs/Sqr/Sign/Min/Max, GCD/LCM, ISqrt/Power, static Parse/TryParse/Pow/Abs/GreatestCommonDivisor/Create/constants and readonly Sign/IsZero/IsOne/IsEven. String ToBigInteger, console/text-file input/output, prompt readers, TryRead preservation, Str/Val, scalar collections and structural output supported. Native overloads dominate BigInteger widening for ordinary arguments. Big buffers charged against execution allocation budget by 32-bit words; shared immutable aliases avoid duplicate charging. Strict metadata/stacks, bilingual parse/cast/division/power/size/resource diagnostics. School BigInteger overloads, remaining .NET members, culture, ordinal loops and original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.biginteger_backend: Native C/C++ backend used by the statically typed Pascal BigInteger implementation. Vendored LibTomMath 1.3.0 with archive SHA-256 and Unlicense, fixed portable 28-bit limbs in uint32_t/uint64_t, no runtime dependency/download. Immutable pimpl C++ values, 65536-bit bound, signed arithmetic/truncating division/remainder, bitwise/sign-extending shifts, radix text, power/sqrt/gcd and checked fixed casts. Double-to-integer truncates fractions; integer-to-double truncates low mantissa bits per source NumericsHelpers (not nearest-even). 165236 backend checks pass with MSVC and independent Clang C/C++ builds; C backend included in Unix sanitizer instrumentation. Additional BigInteger library overloads and full source compatibility remain pending.
typed_capabilities.school_minmax: School MinMax over rank-one arrays/List with integer, int64 or real elements, global/qualified/member forms. Statically typed homogeneous two-field tuple result; original empty-container extrema retained (MaxValue,MinValue; real MaxValue,-MaxValue), nil throws bilingual E_NIL. One bounded/cancellable pass, List version checks, two result cells charged, no Random draws. Opcode validates container/rank/element and exact result field types across all code before execution. BigInteger, lazy sequence of/general IEnumerable and original compiler comparison pending; native deterministic data oracle, extrema, nil/empty, overload/type/metadata and resource cases added.
typed_capabilities.tuples: Immutable reference tuples with 2..7 statically known fields, structural type interning, tuple literal/type syntax, Rec/PABCSystem.Rec, named typed constructor, Item1..Item7 and zero-based integer-literal access. Default nil, bilingual nil-read trap, strict readonly field/ref metadata. Literal assignments may widen element types; stored tuple conversions pending. Records copied by value on construction/read, contained arrays/List shared, array/List cells remain writable through tuple properties. Equality and List.Contains compare tuple contents recursively, with reference identity for array/List elements. Structural output has no inter-field spaces per PABCSystem. Bounded allocations/depth/arity; verifier validates immutable fields and all reachable/unreachable tuple instructions. Deconstruction, ordering, Add/ToArray, Rest/generic interfaces and original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.unicode_character_functions: UpperCase/LowerCase(char/string), UpCase/LowCase(char), character ToUpper/ToLower, IsLetter/IsDigit/IsUpper/IsLower and Code, with declared char extension forms and string ToUpper/ToLower members. Pinned simple Unicode 15.1 casing is locale-independent, preserves unpaired surrogates and maps supplementary scalar pairs in strings; no multi-character expansions. Letter categories Lu/Ll/Lt/Lm/Lo; digit Nd, upper Lu and lower Ll. ToDigit retains its distinct ASCII-only contract. Nil string errors bilingual; string loops bounded/cancellable by scalar work counter, including odd-offset surrogate pairs. Types/signatures verified before execution; culture-specific casing, Unicode-version parity with older .NET and source compiler comparisons pending.
typed_capabilities.unicode_identifiers: Unicode 15.1 BMP letter categories Lu/Ll/Lt/Lm/Lo and underscore start/continue identifiers; only ASCII decimal digits continue, matching source lexer Letter/ID grammar. Checked-in simple lowercase mappings provide locale-independent name matching for variables, types, fields, routines, parameters and unit names. No normalization, combining marks or supplementary identifier letters. UTF-8 byte offsets retained; diagnostic columns now count UTF-16 code units, including supplementary text in strings/comments. Tables reproducible with hash-pinned development-only PowerShell generator; normal builds require no generator/runtime/data download. Source/Unicode tests include case collisions, Unicode field/routine lookup and positioned diagnostics; original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.school_cyrillic: НОД/НОК(int64,int64) with School import and qualification, statically int64 results. Original signed Euclidean remainder and division-before-multiplication preserved, checked MinInt64/-1 remainder/division and absolute-value overflow. НОД(MinInt64,2)=2, НОК(0,MinInt64)=0, НОК(0,0) raises bilingual E_DIV_ZERO. School.Dec uses simple Unicode uppercase mappings before digit validation, including long s and dotless i; culture-specific casing pending. Native exhaustive signed small-pair oracle and boundary/type/scope tests; НОДНОК now returns the signed gcd and nonnegative lcm in a typed tuple; original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.school_folds: School GCD/LCM for array of int64 and up to 4096 listed arguments, subject to the common operand-stack limit. Fixed PABCSystem binary overloads retain precedence for unqualified pairs; qualified School calls select params forms. One argument returns unchanged, including negative/MinInt64; nil/empty arrays raise bilingual E_RANGE. Source multiplication-before-GCD/division, repeated second element, negative-result signs and checked overflow/division-by-zero retained. Array element/rank and opcode signature verified before execution; bounded/cancellable native folds. Native expected-output, overload/type/metadata, boundary, argument-order and resource tests; original compiler comparison pending. BigInteger overloads pending.
typed_capabilities.school_text: School ReplaceLast(var string,string,string), sequential char ReplaceMany, one-pass first-match Translate, substring ReplaceMany over statically known string arrays/List<string> (including mixed pairs), ToInts64(string):array of int64 and Imp(boolean,boolean), plus source extension forms where declared. ReplaceLast captures destination reference once before remaining arguments, uses overlapping last-match search, preserves no-write on no match and separate Delete/Insert/version writes. StringBuilder-derived nil/empty/replacement rules preserved; Translate checks nil source/target only when actually accessed. Substring matching uses bounded/cancellable UTF-16 KMP, replacements are nonoverlapping within a pair and sequential across pairs; missing/nil replacements remove. ToInts64 splits space/TAB/CR/LF and applies StrToInt64. Strict metadata and stack types include mixed container IDs, writable references and fixed int64 elements. 20449 short-string cases plus Unicode, nil, argument-order, readonly/version, bounds/limits and malformed-bytecode cases tested natively. Arr parser accepts up to 4096 values; verifier snapshots only control-flow entries, retaining strict branch/cycle merges and the state budget without quadratic straight-line copies. Explicit IList<T>/other implementors, Regex SwapSubstr and original compiler corpus comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.school_factors: School integer/int64 Factorize/PrimeFactors, PrimeDivisors, PrimeFactorsCount, PrimeDivisorsCount, Divisors and DivisorsCount, with member forms and integer Divizors alias. Small integers widen to integer, longword to int64; result lists preserve chosen integer width, counts return integer. Explicit HIR operation types and bytecode signatures validate list element/result widths before execution. Shared cache operations require one canonical integer-list type across reachable/unreachable module and routine instructions. Source integer cache algorithms and int64 SQUFOF-then-Pollard order, multiplier/polynomial constants, split/recursion strategy and large-composite-factor failure retained. Checked signed intermediates and corrected integer sqrt; portable modular multiplication fixes overflowing Pollard intermediates. Source negative-input delegation, empty factor lists, singleton nonpositive divisors, cache mutation, E_FACTOR, collection versions, cancellation and per-call work/allocation limits covered. Independent trial division/enumerated divisors for -2..1000, near-int64 prime/semiprime, squares, MaxInt64 factorization, width/error/limit regressions. Native expected-output corpus only; original compiler comparison and BigInteger remain pending.
typed_capabilities.school_lists: School Digits(int64[,base]):List<integer>, DigitsToInt64(List<integer>[,base]):int64, integer/list member forms, Primes(integer), Primes(integer,integer) and FirstPrimes(integer). Static HIR/bytecode parameters and list element types verified before execution, including unreachable instruction metadata. Digits returns empty for negative input/base<2; DigitsToInt64 preserves source digit<base validation, negative digits, empty-list zero and checked final power update. Lazy execution-owned initial prime cache is computed by sieve (4793 primes through 46349); small FirstPrimes returns a copy, large calls expose and extend the same cache, including source repeated-call duplicates and observable mutation in range Primes and integer-domain IsPrime. List cells retain version owners; scratch sieves and output cells share allocation budgets and cancellation. Independent trial division checks segmented ranges, near-MaxInt output, aliases, repeated execution, overflow/type/resource failures. Native expected-output corpus only; BigInteger and full source-unit compatibility pending.
typed_capabilities.school_primality: School.IsPrime integer/int64 and integer member forms return statically typed boolean. Integer uses trial division or the execution cache after FirstPrimes/range initialization, preserving observable cache mutation; larger positive int64 uses deterministic first-twelve-prime Miller-Rabin, with the Sorenson/Webster bound covering the domain. Portable uint64 add/shift modular products avoid overflowing intermediate arithmetic and compiler-specific 128-bit requirements. No Random draws; cancellation polled inside computation. Source int64-to-integer delegation retains checked narrowing: n < MinInt32 traps, other n < 2 are false. Independent small sieve, trial division above MaxInt, factored near-limit composites, documented high prime and strong pseudoprime regressions pass native tests. BigInteger and full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.school_bases: With uses School: int64 Bin/Oct/Hex, School.Dec(string,base) with simple Unicode uppercase, ToBase(int64,base), BinFormat optional byte width/separator, PerfectSquare and real SinDegrees/CosDegrees/TanDegrees. Catalog owns unit exports; qualified names and integer ToBase/PerfectSquare methods supported. Dec(string,base) works in value/statement positions while ordinal Dec(var) retains mutation. Bases 2..36 checked before processing, all digits validated before overflow accumulation; empty Dec input is zero. Bin/Oct/Hex use magnitude with native checked MinInt64 overflow, source negative/zero ToBase returns 0, BinFormat supports MinInt64 magnitude, minimum byte width, nil separator and UTF-16 budgets/cancellation. PerfectSquare uses bounded unsigned intermediate products; degree trig retains finite-real policy. BigInteger, culture-specific casing, general sequences/delegates and Addr32/CalcIP pending. Native expected-output corpus only; original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.string_arrays: ToWords/ToLines/ToIntegers/ToReals produce statically interned rank-one string/integer/real arrays. ToWords supports default space, delimiter string, char params and typed char arrays; empty sets and nil char arrays split Unicode whitespace, typed nil delimiter strings trap, untyped nil delimiters require an explicit type. Empty entries removed for words, retained for lines with CRLF/LF/CR matching and no additional Unicode line separators. ToIntegers uses source prefix parsing/Unicode spaces, including whitespace-only failure and MinInt special stop; count overload allocates first, reads exactly N and permits nil source for N=0. ToReals uses space/TAB/CR/LF tokenization and optional decimal separator validated before splitting, retaining finite-real policy. Fixed UTF-16 delimiter bitset avoids quadratic searches; cell budgets, cancellation and bytecode type/rank/parameter validation retained. NumberFormatInfo, Single and original compiler corpus comparison pending; native expected-output corpus only.
typed_capabilities.string_numeric_members: String.ReadInteger/ReadReal/ReadWord and functional forms use zero-based typed var cursors, checked offset arithmetic and shared prefix/word parsing. Cursor is committed after success; method ReadWord commits even an empty EOF result. String.ToInteger/ToReal/IsInteger/IsReal support omitted parentheses and functional calls. ToInteger(integer default) and ToReal(real default) use checked TryParse profiles; defaults evaluate before the call even for valid strings. ToReal(string separator) selects a distinct static overload. Nil ToInteger/IsInteger/plain ToReal traps, nil IsReal is false and nil ToReal(real default) returns the default. Metadata, references and types remain verified. Finite-real, culture, NumberFormatInfo/BigInteger and full original compiler comparison restrictions remain; native expected-output tests only.
typed_capabilities.string_cursor: ReadIntegerFromString/ReadRealFromString/ReadWordFromString/StringIsEmpty and TryReadIntegerFromString/TryReadRealFromString use typed integer var cursors and UTF-16 positions starting at one. Unicode whitespace, integer prefix versus whole-word try parsing, source MinInt immediate prefix stop, end-of-string words, nil/bounds/format/overflow errors and cancellation retained. Try forms restore cursors on failure, preserving integer output or zeroing real output. Stable references, aliasing cursor/result and List mutation versions follow actual cursor writes, including failed try rollback. Source/receiver/result types and opcode metadata/stacks verified before execution. Finite-real and culture restrictions remain; native expected-output corpus only, full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.string_conversions: Str(number/string,var string), formatted Str arguments, Val(string,var number,var integer), TryStrToInt/Int64/Real/Float and string.TryToInteger/TryToReal are statically bound native operations. Str preserves nil string identity. Val uses codes 0/1. Source custom integer ParseCore failures preserve the old destination, while other fixed integers and real TryParse failures write zero; nil integer input traps E_NIL, other numeric nil input fails with zero. Unicode integer whitespace versus ASCII/NUL padding for other integers retained; unsigned negative zero accepted, real Float style has no grouping. Stable receivers, source-first argument order, aliasing and List version changes are checked. Finite-real policy retained; Single, mutable culture, nonfinite values and full original compiler/version comparison pending. Native expected-output corpus only.
typed_capabilities.try_read: TryRead(var target[,message]) for all implemented fixed integers, BigInteger, real and boolean. Stable reference captured before message evaluation; fields/array/List cells supported. Success writes only after parse; malformed/out-of-range tokens, EOF, invalid UTF-8 and host input/prompt-output failures return false with the old value retained. Token consumption and shared input cursor retained; no Readln skip. Only nonempty or nil messages print, using mutable PrintDelimDefault; empty message produces no output. Errors evaluating receiver/message occur outside the helper. Resource limits, cancellation and VM faults are not swallowed. Failed List reads do not invalidate enumeration, successful writes do. Signature/rank/reference stack verified before execution. Single and full original compiler comparison pending; native expected-output corpus only.
typed_capabilities.print_delimiter: Global Print/Println, qualified PABCSystem forms, Text-first calls and existing Text methods share mutable typed string PrintDelimDefault. Default space, empty suppression, nil literal, formatted/structural arguments and all-values-before-output evaluation supported. Global slot is allocated only when referenced, initialized before user global initializers and reset per execution. Routine accesses and var passing use verified global cell references; local declarations/routines may shadow names and qualification bypasses shadowing. The same execution-owned delimiter controls prompts from all implemented console input functions. Bytecode verifies Print metadata, stack types and delimiter global index/type/ownership. Explicit params object-array expansion, array covariance, unsupported custom ToString and full original compiler comparison pending; native expected-output corpus covers console/files/input.
typed_capabilities.formatted_output: Write/Writeln and Text output parse value:width[:precision] into statically bound native FormatValue, bypassing user routine shadowing for syntax sugar. Values/width/precision evaluate left-to-right before the enclosing output call; subsequent arguments cannot mutate the rendered string. Two colons require an original real operand, width/precision require integer-compatible static types. Scalars and supported record/array/List values use bounded UTF-16 padding and existing real formatting. Read and ordinary call colon syntax rejected. Native corpus covers console/files, evaluation order, UTF-16 widths and failures before output; full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.object_output: ObjectToString and FormatValue support all implemented scalars, nominal records, rank-one/two arrays and List<T> with recursively supported static element/field types. Records use field declaration order, parentheses and commas without names/spaces; sequences use brackets; empty rank-two arrays use [[]]. Source truncation differs: arrays longer than 100 show 99 elements, lists of 101 remain complete and lists of 102+ show 100. Matrix trimming applies per dimension. Nil is literal nil, strings/chars are unquoted UTF-16. Active-path repeats use (...); shared non-cyclic objects render again. Bounded 1 Mi UTF-16 result and cancellation. Global Write/Writeln and Text output accept these types, capture all argument values before rendering, and retain record value copies/reference identity. Typed HIR/opcode verification rejects unsupported type graphs before execution; no dynamic object fallback. Custom ToString, remaining Collections class formatting and full original compiler corpus comparison pending; native expected-output corpus only.
typed_capabilities.rectangular_arrays: Static rank-two arrays, shape-carrying row-major storage, two-index read/ref/write, construction, routines/var/records and foreach. Rank/element form a unique static type. Length total/dimension, High dimension-zero bound, strict member nil guards, GetLength/GetUpperBound/GetLowerBound/Rank, RowCount/ColCount, Copy/member Copy. SetLength always creates a new rank-two object and copies the intersection, capturing source before dimensions with original repeated indexed-target evaluation. Matrix Arrays random factories/fill and PABCSystem MatrRandom/Integer/Real defaults implemented; zero cells draw nothing. WriteMatrix supports structural value width and real abs(digits)/negative-width left alignment; member Write uses a trailing delimiter per cell and newline per row. FormatValue scalar/structural overloads share bounded C++ formatting. Qualified Arrays/PABCSystem generic array operations supported. Type ranks, indices, stack operands and output modes verified, allocation/cancellation limits retained. Ranks 3+, fixed bounds, range objects and full original compiler/formatting-version parity pending; native expected-output corpus only.
typed_capabilities.console_output: Execution-owned C++ ConsoleOutput encodes UTF-16 to UTF-8 across calls, retaining a final high surrogate. Shared by Write/Writeln, Arrays/Collections output and prompts. Empty writes retain state; paired UTF-16 units across writes become a single scalar; invalid sequences use U+FFFD. Native policy finalizes a pending surrogate on halt and best-effort error cleanup without replacing the original error. Output budget counts emitted UTF-8 bytes. Host ios_base::failure converts to bilingual E_OUTPUT/E_INPUT; ordinary EOF survives host exception flags. Source Console/StreamWriter AutoFlush behavior inspected; no CLR shipped or original compiler run for the new expected-output corpus. Dynamic encodings and complete original process-exit behavior pending.
typed_capabilities.console_input: Execution-owned UTF-8/UTF-16 ConsoleInput cursor shared by Read/Readln and Arrays.ReadArray. Up to 16 writable scalar receivers are evaluated once directly before each individual read, matching original compiler lowering; earlier reads are visible to later receiver expressions. Read()/Read with no arguments is a no-op. Numeric tokens skip ASCII space/tab/CR/LF; strings read remainder before CR/LF and leave terminator; char reads a UTF-16 unit. Character EOF and a Read(string) call already at EOF return the source #65535 sentinel. Readln skips through #10 or EOF and supports omitted/empty parentheses. ReadArray supports integer/real/string arrays, including empty-array final line skip and source string-array empty-remainder behavior. Typed nil traps before IO; List writes invalidate enumeration. Numeric range, UTF-8, 1 MiB line and cancellation limits retained. Windows stdin binary retains CRLF. Zero-argument ReadInteger/ReadInt64/ReadReal/ReadBoolean/ReadChar and Readln forms, ReadString/ReadlnString and ReadLexem implemented, including source string prompts followed by PrintDelimDefault (default space). String functions consume CR/LF and return empty at EOF, unlike Read(var string). Shared typed stdlib Context provides IO/files/random with output limits. Write/Writeln evaluate all values before output; Read retains sequential lowering. BigInteger, tuple and complete interactive/redirected parity pending; native corpora only.
typed_capabilities.bitwise: Integer not/and/or/xor for all eight fixed integral types; same-type narrow and unsigned bit operations preserve static type. Compatible mixed integers widen to a common type; nonnegative uint64 literal contexts checked before execution. Small integer shifts promote to integer; integer/int64/longword/uint64 shifts preserve width. Shift count is integer, masked to 5/6 low bits, including negative counts. Signed shr sign-extends, unsigned shr zero-fills; bit_cast and unsigned operations avoid signed C++ overflow. Boolean xor evaluates both operands, boolean and/or retain short circuit. Full mixed overload/constant-conversion parity and original compiler comparison pending; no hex literals yet.
typed_capabilities.array_output: With uses Arrays: WriteArray/WritelnArray and array.Write/Writeln with an optional string delimiter defaulting to a space. One-dimensional arrays of scalars, records and nested arrays/lists supported; delimiter appears only between values. Global output accepts typed nil arrays and produces no elements; member output traps nil. Empty Writeln produces a newline. Receiver and delimiter evaluated once in source order, shared output/cancellation limits and bytecode metadata/stack checks retained. Rectangular structural output is implemented through statically checked ObjectToString. Native expected-output tests; no original compiler execution for new corpus.
typed_capabilities.extended_math: PABCSystem Atan2, scaled Hypot, Lerp and Remap, GCD(integer,integer):integer, GCD(int64,int64):int64 and LCM(int64,int64):int64. GCD rejects signed minimum even paired with zero; LCM returns zero before checking signed minimum and checks division-before-product overflow. Real finite-result and zero-division policy retained. BigInteger overloads pending. Native expected-output tests, no original compiler execution for the new corpus.
typed_capabilities.sequence_mutations: Typed Reverse for arrays/List and writable UTF-16 strings, full/ranged forms; List.Reverse methods. Global Shuffle and returning array/List Shuffle share execution RandomContext and preserve Fisher-Yates draws; 0/1 elements draw nothing. Exact-type generic var Swap, array.Swap(i,j), record copies, stable element cells, once-only source evaluation. Checked bounds/nil, List version invalidation including empty Reverse ranges, cancellation and bytecode verification. Explicit System.Random overloads pending; native expected-output corpus, no original compiler execution.
typed_capabilities.random: Execution-owned C++ RandomContext shared across routines. Explicit integer seed uses the .NET 10 compatibility subtractive generator with defined wrapping initialization; no seed uses xoshiro256** and native random_device entropy. Randomize/SetRandomSeed, Random() and integer/real upper bounds, integer/real/char pairs, RandomReal defaults/rounding implemented. Negative integer max rejects without drawing; zero max consumes a seeded sample. Inclusive integer pair retains source b+1 checked overflow, large signed ranges use the compatibility two-sample path. Reversed real/char/integer bounds and original RandomReal clamp behavior preserved. Native corpus and golden seeded sequence pass; no original Pascal compiler execution for the new corpus. MIT algorithm notice shipped; no CLR dependency. Range wrappers, tuples, sequences, rnd and user System.Random objects pending.
typed_capabilities.random_arrays: Typed integer/real ArrRandom, ArrRandomInteger and ArrRandomReal factories with implemented source defaults. Arrays CreateRandomIntegerArray/CreateRandomRealArray and FillByRandom require uses Arrays and support qualified calls. Global/member FillRandom follows PABCSystem. Arrays integer default is 0..99 versus PABCSystem 0..100. Source Arrays real fill omits adding the lower bound; PABCSystem real fill uses the full interval. Arguments and receiver evaluate once in source order; empty arrays do not draw or validate scalar bounds. Bytecode verifies array element and mode/argument types. Allocation and cancellation limits retained. Rectangular matrix overloads are implemented; range-object overloads remain pending.
typed_capabilities.wide_unsigned: longword/uint64 preserve uint32/uint64 throughout runtime values, IO, aggregates and routines. Decimal literals above MaxInt64 infer uint64 up to MaxUInt64. Longword arithmetic/negation promotes to int64; uint64 arithmetic stays uint64, with checked add/subtract/multiply/div/mod and unary negation. For, foreach and Inc/Dec supported; signed step is integer for longword, int64 for uint64. Sqr(word/longword/uint64) returns uint64. Typed Ord/Abs/Sign/Min/Max/Succ/Pred and checked integral casts including integer/int64. UInt64 integer contexts preserve precision; signed variables require explicit conversion, nonnegative constants are checked before execution. Text Read/Write and console Readln retain the full range. Full mixed conversion and overflow-mode compatibility pending; fixed integer bitwise operations are implemented. Native expected-output corpus; source declarations inspected, full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.boolean_ordinals: Succ/Pred and Inc/Dec toggle boolean values, including Succ(true) and Pred(false), following PABCSystem source. Inc/Dec reject a step argument. Ordered comparisons and for false..true / true downto false supported with readonly counters and boundary checks. List writes still invalidate enumeration.
typed_capabilities.small_integers: Distinct byte/shortint/smallint uint8/int8/int16 types throughout locals, arrays, records, routines and collections. Constants checked before execution; explicit casts and Inc/Dec checked at runtime. Safe widening into integer/int64/real, byte into word/smallint and shortint into smallint. Arithmetic promotes to integer. Array inference joins compatible small types before execution. Console Readln, Text Read/Write, ordinal for/foreach, sorting and collection mutation supported. Ord/Succ/Pred/Abs and two-argument Min/Max preserve type; Sign and Sqr(byte/shortint/smallint) return integer. Sqr(word) returns uint64; no silent fallback to int64. General implicit narrowing, full generic math overloads and original overflow modes pending. Native corpus passes expected-output checks; source result declarations inspected, full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.file_operations_unit: With uses FilesOperations: ReadFileToEnd(string):string and WriteStringToFile(string,string):procedure, including qualified calls. Native Text helpers retain IO limits, source positions, shared open-object tracking and per-execution cwd. Read normalizes CR/LF/CRLF to the host newline and adds one after each line including an unterminated final line, unlike ReadAllText. Empty file returns empty string. typed_capabilities.string_construction: StringOfChar(char,integer), string/char repetition with integer/word in either operand order, preserving evaluation order. Negative repetition returns empty; StringOfChar rejects negative length. Length limits checked before allocation; nil/empty repetition short-circuits. Adjacent quoted and decimal sharp literals form UTF-16 strings preserving NUL and paired/unpaired surrogates. String.Length property traps on nil; ToDigit(char) and member syntax accept ASCII 0..9 only, with bilingual E_FORMAT. Native expected-output tests; full original compiler comparison pending.
typed_capabilities.characters: UTF-16 char and unsigned 16-bit word with distinct static types. Single-code-unit quoted literals infer char; decimal #0..#65535 literals preserve NUL and surrogates. Ord/OrdUnicode(char) returns word; Chr/ChrUnicode, char/word casts, Succ/Pred, checked Inc/Dec, comparisons and char-to-string widening. Word widens to integer/int64/real; arithmetic promotes to integer. String indexing is one-based and supports reads/writes through writable string locals, record fields and array/List elements; var/input/Inc on string indices pending. Foreach strings captures once and yields UTF-16 code units; nil traps. For char/word handles endpoint values without an extra step. Read(Text,char/word), ReadChar/ReadlnChar and Text members preserve spaces. Character EOF returns #65535 following the source StreamReader.Read cast. Text writes preserve paired surrogates across calls. Full numeric narrowing, encodings and culture-specific Unicode casing pending. Source-inspected native corpus passes expected-output checks; no full original compiler comparison.
typed_capabilities.foreach: Strings, arrays and List<T>; declared/inferred/explicit iteration variables or an existing routine-local variable. Source captured once, element type checked before execution with widening only. Records copy by value; class/array references retain identity. Iteration variable is readonly. Nil source traps E_NIL; empty source has no iterations. Array element changes remain visible, array-variable reassignment/resize leaves the captured source intact. List versions detect structural changes, index/record-field writes, sorting and filling on the next step with bilingual E_MODIFIED. Nested reference-object state changes do not invalidate the outer list. Break/Exit skip further version checks. Lazy sequences, tuple deconstruction, index clauses and generic enumerable loading pending. Collections.pas classes do not expose enumeration in the source and remain unsupported. Native corpus passes expected-output tests; full original compiler comparison not performed.
typed_capabilities.control_flow: If/while, for to/downto with all implemented integer, boolean or char counters, repeat/until, break/continue and Exit. For counters may be declared in the header (optional explicit type) or reuse a routine-local variable. Bounds evaluated once with the source converter order: new counter initializer before finish, existing counter finish before initializer. Final boundary values do not overflow. Direct counter writes, Inc/Dec, input and var-argument passing in the body are rejected before execution. Repeat declarations are visible in the condition and scoped to the loop. Bytecode uses verified typed comparisons/branches and retains instruction/output/allocation/cancellation limits. For step, other ordinal counters and Function Result counters remain pending. Native loop corpus passes expected-output tests; full original compiler comparison not performed.
typed_capabilities.arrays: Dynamic, jagged and rectangular rank-two arrays; zero-based indices, reference assignment, shape-preserving Copy and intersection-preserving SetLength. Static rank and element, row-major foreach, shape queries and native matrix factories/fill/output. Fixed bounds, ranks 3+ and complete generic/source-unit compatibility pending.
typed_capabilities.records: Nominal records, nested fields, value assignment; cyclic type definitions pending.
typed_capabilities.routines: Typed user functions/procedures, value and var parameters, recursion, Result and Exit; overloads, nested routines, defaults and user generics pending.
typed_capabilities.collections: List<T>: construction, Count, index, Add, RemoveAt, Clear, Contains. With uses Collections: Stack<T>, Queue<T>, DynArray<T>, SimpleSet<T>, AssocArray<K,V>, LinkedList<T>, LinkedListNode<T>, SingleNode<T>. SingleNode has typed constructor(data,next) and writable Data/Next; it is distinct from LinkedListNode. All eight source class families now have a basic native profile. Execution-owned node arena uses weak links. Generic defaults preserve nil strings, including record fields. Other collection features pending.
typed_capabilities.strings: UTF-16 strings with a distinct typed nil value. Original normal/generic initialization, comparison, concatenation, output, mutations and implemented library functions handle nil. Queue text concatenation treats nil as empty; collection element ToString reports E_NIL. Numeric conversions retain their different nil rules.
typed_capabilities.files: UTF-8 whole-text and line-array IO, Unicode paths, 1 MiB per text file. GetDir/GetCurrentDir, ChDir/SetCurrentDir with per-execution cwd, MkDir/CreateDir, empty-directory RmDir/RemoveDir, DeleteFile, RenameFile/RenameDirectory and lexical ChangeFileNameExtension. Rename preserves binary data and rejects an occupied destination using OS exclusive operations; Unix file fallback uses hard link or no-overwrite copy. Cross-filesystem file moves copy then delete and are not atomic; directory cross-filesystem moves fail. Windows blocks moving the selected directory/ancestors; Unix updates the execution cwd. Host cwd is unchanged. Unlike the original Windows CP1251 text default.
typed_capabilities.text_files: Text/TextFile default objects, shared reference assignment, Assign/AssignFile, Reset/Rewrite/Append with optional filename, Close/CloseFile, Flush, Read/Readln, Write/Writeln, Eof/Eoln/SeekEof/SeekEoln, OpenRead/OpenWrite/OpenAppend and typed Read*/Readln* functions. All IO argument types checked before execution. UTF-8 readers retain a snapshot until Reset; buffered writers flush on Flush/Close or RAII cleanup. Limit 1 MiB per file, 64 open objects. Repeated Rewrite preserves pending buffer and tail. Native text file and method fixtures pass expected-output tests; full comparison against original not performed. Binary/typed files, encodings, standard input/output objects, dual-mode streams and full original sharing rules pending.
typed_capabilities.text_members: ReadInteger/ReadReal/ReadBoolean/ReadString, ReadWord, ReadlnInteger/ReadlnReal/ReadlnBoolean/ReadlnString, Readln, ReadToEnd, Name/FullName, Reset/Rewrite/Append, Close/Flush, Eof/Eoln/SeekEof/SeekEoln, Write/Writeln/Print/Println, Erase/Rename. Zero-argument calls support parentheses or omission. Output accepts up to 16 statically checked scalar/record/array/List values; receiver and arguments are captured once before output. Print appends a space to every value; Println has spaces only between values. ReadToEnd consumes the remainder with original line endings. Name/FullName before Assign and ReadToEnd without a reader report bilingual E_NIL. Lines, Encoding overloads and complete overload/encoding parity remain pending.

text_changes: Erase(Text) and Rename(Text,string), including member syntax. Procedures report bilingual E_IO on failure; an absent file in an existing parent is ignored by Erase. Rename preserves the assigned Name/FullName until Assign, never replaces an occupied destination, and operates on binary files without the text size limit. Windows execution-local open Text objects block file deletion, file moves and containing-directory moves, including through DeleteFile/RenameFile/RenameDirectory; Assign does not change the recorded open path. Unix permits open-file unlink/move with reader snapshots retained. Interprocess and complete symbolic-link sharing compatibility remain pending. Native expected-output corpus added; full original compiler comparison not performed.

modules.name: Arrays
modules.notes: Native rank-one/two profile: sort/fill, array/matrix random factories/fill, ReadArray(integer/real/string), WriteArray/WritelnArray, WriteMatrix and array output methods with qualified names. User comparison interfaces and complete source-unit loading/compatibility remain pending; not a complete module port.

modules.name: Collections
modules.notes: All eight class families have a basic native profile: SingleNode, Stack, Queue, DynArray, SimpleSet, AssocArray, LinkedList and LinkedListNode. Types are static; records copy by value and collections/nodes preserve references. Original resize/formatting/rewiring rules are retained, including generic nil-string defaults. Node arena and weak links prevent C++ ownership cycles. Text output is scalar-only; Queue concatenates nil as empty, while element ToString traps on nil. Property var-arguments/direct record-field writes, compound-element text output, inherited .NET behavior and source-unit loading remain pending.

modules.name: Events
modules.notes: The shipped source is an empty compatibility unit with no exports or initialization. Uses is accepted without introducing invented APIs.

modules.name: FilesOperations
modules.notes: Both exported routines implemented natively with source line-normalization semantics, unit scope and qualified calls. UTF-8 file policy differs from the source Windows CP1251 default; encoding/sharing compatibility remains pending.

modules.notes: The shipped source is an empty compatibility unit with no exports or initialization. Uses is accepted without introducing invented APIs.

modules.name: School
modules.notes: Native fixed-integer primality, factorization/divisors and counts, Digits/DigitsToInt64, prime lists, base conversion with simple Unicode casing, byte formatting, perfect-square, degree-trig, text replacement/translation, ToInts64, Imp, int64 GCD/LCM params/array, НОД/НОК/НОДНОК and numeric array/List MinMax profile. BigInteger, culture-specific casing, full IList/sequence interfaces, Regex SwapSubstr, delegates, networking classes and complete source-unit compatibility pending.
